title: User crash dumps
whyItMatters: Crash dumps can capture process memory, which may include personal data or secrets at the moment an application failed.
source: Microsoft Learn Windows Error Reporting: per-user crash dumps stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%/CrashDumps
notes: Only .dmp files are counted. The machine-wide C:/Windows/MEMORY.DMP needs elevation and is deliberately out of scope. No dump is opened.
